lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern, forming vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the circular blobs, creating a series of light-colored vertical rungs across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance upper edges to shadowed lower edges, extending longitudinally along the flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct high-contrast silhouettes representing secondary objects located inferior to the pectoral fin.
